Processors.

Understand the chip at the center of your PC.

01

Cores and threads

Cores handle processing work. Extra threads can help supported workloads; more cores do not always mean faster games.

02

Clock speed

How frequently a processor operates. GHz comparisons are most useful within the same architecture.

03

The CPU must match the motherboard socket, chipset support, and BIOS. Use the builder to check indexed compatibility.
